title: One listener on the parent

blocks.md:
## Delegation

One listener on `ul#list` can handle clicks on any `button` inside, including buttons you add later. Check `event.target.matches("button")` or use `closest("button")`.

You do not bind each button by hand. On this pick board, North and East are already listed. Clicking East should write `East` into `#picked` from `data-name`.

blocks.promptMd: A parent listener (bubble) hears clicks on a button appended after bind?

choices.md: No — you had to bind that button
Yes — the click bubbles to the parent

blocks.promptMd: A parent bubble listener misses buttons appended after you bound it.
blocks.explainMd: The click still bubbles to the parent. New children are covered without a new listener.

blocks.promptMd: > Clicking a button in `#list` should set `#picked` to that button’s `data-name`.

hintLadder.md: Use `closest("button")` so a click on the button text still counts.

description: One listener on a parent can handle many children.
